## 

1.  Load libraries

    ```{r}
    library(tidyverse)
    library(broom)
    library(purrr)
    library(ggrepel)
    ```

2.  Load datasets

    ```{r}

    ```

3.  Convert counts into long format

    ```{r}
    counts_long <- counts |>
      select(-total_counts) |>
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -gene_id,
        names_to = "sample_id",
        values_to = "count"
      )
    ```

4.  Joins count with metadata

    ```{r}
    counts_aug <- counts_long |>
      left_join(metadata, by = "sample_id")
    ```

5.  Checking any missing value

    ```{r}
    counts_aug |>
      summarise(
        total_samples = n_distinct(sample_id),
        missing_stimulus = sum(is.na(stimulus)),
        missing_time = sum(is.na(time)),
        missing_donor = sum(is.na(donor))
      )
    ```

6.  Set factors levels

    ```{r}
    counts_aug <- counts_aug |>
      mutate(
        stimulus = factor(
          stimulus,
          levels = c(
            "Control_group",
            "C_albicans",
            "A_fumigatus",
            "R_oryzae"
          )
        ),
        time = factor(
          time,
          levels = c("4h", "24h")
        ),
        donor = factor(donor)
      )
    ```

7.   Calculate total reads, CPM and log2(CPM + 1)

    ```{r}
    counts_aug <- counts_aug |>
      group_by(sample_id) |>
      mutate(
        total_reads = sum(count),
        cpm = count / total_reads * 1e6,
        log_cpm = log2(cpm + 1)
      ) |>
      ungroup()
    ```

8.  Check CPM normalisation

    ```{r}
    cpm_check <- counts_aug |>
      group_by(sample_id) |>
      summarise(
        total_cpm = sum(cpm),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    cpm_check
    ```

9.  Filter lower expressed genes

    ```{r}
    counts_aug <- counts_aug |>
      group_by(gene_id) |>
      filter(sum(count >= 10) >= 8) |>
      ungroup()
    ```

10. After filtering, how many genes remain

    ```{r}
    counts_aug |>
      summarise(number_of_genes = n_distinct(gene_id))
    ```

11. Select only R.Oryzae and control

    ```{r}
    counts_oryzae <- counts_aug |>
      filter(
        stimulus %in% c("Control_group",
                        "R_oryzae")
      )
    ```

    ```{r}
    counts_oryzae |>
      distinct(sample_id, time, stimulus, donor) |>
      count(time, stimulus)
    ```

12.  Check donor matching

    ```{r}
    sample_check <- counts_oryzae |>
      distinct(sample_id, time, stimulus) |>
      count(time, stimulus) |>
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = stimulus,
        values_from = n,
        values_fill = 0
      )

    sample_check
    ```

13. Prepare data for modelling

    ```{r}
    counts_aug_long <- counts_oryzae |>
      select(
        gene_id,
        sample_id,
        donor,
        time,
        stimulus,
        log_cpm
      )
    ```

14. Nest data by gene and time

    ```{r}
    counts_aug_long_nested <- counts_aug_long |>
      group_by(gene_id, time) |>
      nest() |>
      ungroup()

    counts_aug_long_nested
    ```

15. Fit linear models

    ```{r}
    counts_aug_long_nested <- counts_aug_long_nested |>
      mutate(
        model_object = map(
          .x = data,
          .f = ~ lm(
            formula = log_cpm ~ donor + stimulus,
            data = .x
          )
        )
      )
    ```

We fit one model for each gene at 4h and another at 24h.

10. Extract model estimates

    ```{r}
    counts_aug_long_nested <- counts_aug_long_nested |>
      mutate(
        model_object_tidy = map(
          .x = model_object,
          .f = ~ tidy(
            x = .x,
            conf.int = TRUE,
            conf.level = 0.95
          )
        )
      )
    ```

11. Combine model results

    ```{r}
    gene_estimates <- counts_aug_long_nested |>
      unnest(model_object_tidy)
    ```

12. Select the R. oryzae effect

    ```{r}
    gene_estimates <- gene_estimates |>
      filter(term == "stimulusR_oryzae") |>
      select(
        gene_id,
        time,
        p.value,
        estimate,
        conf.low,
        conf.high
      ) |>
      ungroup()
    ```

13. Adjust p-values and identify differentially expressed genes

    ```{r}
    gene_estimates <- gene_estimates |>
      group_by(time) |>
      mutate(
        q.value = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
        expression = case_when(
          q.value < 0.05 & estimate > 1 ~ "Upregulated",
          q.value < 0.05 & estimate < -1 ~ "Downregulated",
          TRUE ~ "Not significant"
        )
      ) |>
      ungroup()
    ```

14. Count significant genes:

    ```{r}
    gene_estimates |>
      count(time, expression)
    ```

<!-- -->

14. Save results

    ```{r}
    gene_estimates |>
      write_tsv("data/05_gene_estimates.tsv.gz")
    ```

15. Check number of gene estimates

    ```{r}
    gene_estimates |>
      count(time)
    ```

16. Check missing p-values

    ```{r}
    gene_estimates |>
      summarise(
        total_genes = n(),
        missing_estimates = sum(is.na(estimate)),
        missing_pvalues = sum(is.na(p.value))
      )
    ```

17. Volcanno plot of gene expression for 4h

    ```{r}

    p1 <- gene_estimates |>
      filter(time == "4h") |>
      mutate(
        neg_log10_q = -log10(pmax(q.value, 1e-300))
      ) |>
      arrange(desc(neg_log10_q)) |>
      mutate(
        lbl = ifelse(
          expression != "Not significant" &
          row_number() <= 20,
          gene_id,
          ""
        )
      ) |>
      ggplot(
        aes(
          x = estimate,
          y = neg_log10_q
        )
      ) +

      geom_point(
        aes(colour = expression),
        size = 1.8,
        alpha = 0.25
      ) +

      geom_text_repel(
        aes(label = lbl),
        colour = "black",
        size = 3,
        max.overlaps = 30,
        box.padding = 0.4,
        point.padding = 0.2
      ) +

      geom_vline(
        xintercept = 0,
        colour = "black",
        linewidth = 0.5
      ) +

      scale_colour_manual(
        values = c(
          "Upregulated" = "red",
          "Downregulated" = "blue",
          "Not significant" = "grey70"
        )
      ) +

      labs(
        title = "R. oryzae Stimulation at 4 Hours",
        subtitle = "Compared with unstimulated RPMI control",
        x = "Estimated difference",
        y = "-log10(q-value)",
        colour = "Expression"
      ) +

      theme_bw(base_size = 14) +

      theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey90"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "grey95"),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20)
      )

    p1

    ```
